name: Oysters R Us - Wilderness, Garden Route
address: Oysters R Us, entrance now opposite Timberlake Village, halfway between Wilderness & Sedgefield, N2 Highway, Wilderness East, Wilderness, 6560, South Africa
description_short: Fresh oysters and seafood platters served beside the N2, halfway between Wilderness and Sedgefield.
description_long:
Tucked away beside the N2 between Wilderness and Sedgefield, Oysters R Us has earned its reputation as a Garden Route seafood stop worth planning your journey around. The open-air setup keeps things relaxed and unpretentious, with tables shaded by trees and the sound of traffic replaced by conversation and laughter.

The menu centres on what they do best: fresh oysters served natural, grilled, or topped with creative combinations. Their seafood platters are generous and straightforward, featuring line fish, calamari, and prawns alongside proper chips and salads. The sushi selection surprises first-timers, with well-executed rolls that hold their own against coastal competitors.

What makes this place special is the consistent quality and the fact that it feels like a local secret despite the highway location. Families gather here on weekends, couples stop for lunch on road trips, and regulars know to arrive early when the oysters are at their freshest. The entrance is now opposite Timberlake Village, making it easier to find than ever.
